intro:
Planning a residential move in Wilnecote? Jimmys Removals delivers an efficient, reliable removals service across this historic, well-connected southern borough of Tamworth. Home to Wilnecote railway station and adjacent to Junction 10 of the M42, Wilnecote features a broad property spectrum, encompassing Victorian terraced cottages along Watling Street, mature post-war semi-detached houses on Hockley Road, and modern executive detached developments around Overwoods Road and Pennymoor Drive. Our dedicated moving teams take complete responsibility for your transition, providing careful packing, heavy lifting, and secure vehicular transit.

Every move is executed with modern, low-emission Luton box vans equipped with electric tail lifts, allowing heavy furniture and appliances to be safely lifted from road level without manual strain. We wrap all upholstered items in thick transit blankets, supply waterproof mattress bags, and lay down heavy-duty protective floor runners. Backed by Fully insured and fixed, all-inclusive quotations, we guarantee a punctual, organized moving day for your Wilnecote home.
localKnowledge:
Wilnecote sits at the strategic crossroads of the B5404 Watling Street and the M42 Junction 10 corridor, making regional road connectivity exceptional. However, local traffic around Wilnecote railway station level crossing and Overwoods Road can become congested during peak morning commuting hours. Our removal drivers monitor live traffic feeds and plan arrival times to avoid level crossing delays, ensuring your moving day timetable stays strictly on schedule.

In older parts of the village near the parish church and Quarry Hill, narrow side lanes and high stone retaining walls require attentive vehicle placement. Our 3.5-tonne Luton vehicles are designed to turn easily in restricted residential cul-de-sacs where larger 7.5-tonne trucks cannot enter. When delivering to newer estates near Overwoods, we liaise with homeowners to coordinate parking near front thresholds, minimising carry distances and expediting unloading.
